message:
## Vulnerability Digest

No new vulnerabilities were verified as relevant to the monitored products or components during the last 24 hours (2026-08-23 05:10 IST to 2026-08-24 05:10 IST).

The three default product lists were combined and deduplicated before screening. Fresh CVE records, GitHub Security Advisories, vendor notices, CISA-related sources, and credible security reporting were checked. Candidate reports were excluded when they were outside the time window, affected only an unlisted add-on or adjacent project, or could not be tied confidently to a monitored product.

The dedicated MongoDB ecosystem sweep covered MongoDB Server and editions, mongod, mongos, Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, mongosh, database tools, Kubernetes Operator, drivers, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, and maintained libraries. No credible MongoDB-related vulnerability was newly published or substantively updated in the window.

No immediate vulnerability-specific review is recommended from this run. Continue routine patch and advisory monitoring. No possible matches needing review remained after validation.

Sources checked included the [MongoDB alerts page](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts), [NVD data feeds](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/data-feeds), the [CVE List](https://github.com/CVEProject/cvelistV5), and the [GitHub Advisory Database](https://github.com/advisories).
